entries.zh: 赶上、恰逢其时（赴着/赶着）；错过时机、不合时
entries.en: to arrive just in time, to catch the right moment (a tiempos); untimely, at the wrong moment (abuntiempos)
entries.notes: 汉栏首字赴/赶存疑；西语 abuntiempos 疑为 a des tiempos（不合时）之讹，次要义项从之。

entries.zh: 如期前往、按时赴约（赴日）；时而、有时
entries.en: to attend on the appointed day; at times, occasionally (por vezes)
to pick up, raise or poke with a point (as in trimming the lamp, picar el candil)
to trim or stir up the lamp; to light the lamp
gruel, rice porridge; (New Spain usage) atole, maize gruel

entries.notes: 西语栏 arstle qxers. 不可辨读，汉栏中字[疑]，闽南栏有 T99 污损，四栏不足互证。

entries.zh: 〔语义无法定夺〕疑指粥黏稠（糜胶胶）或搅粥（搅搅）
entries.en: 〔gloss cannot be determined〕 probably thick, glue-like gruel, or stirring the gruel
entries.notes: 西语栏 asterali- 截断不可解，汉栏'教教'非常用词，疑为'胶胶/搅搅'之讹。

entries.zh: 煮粥、熬粥（首字存疑，或作'餵'：餵粥）
entries.en: to cook porridge or gruel; first character doubtful (perhaps 'to feed porridge')
entries.notes: 首字莫/餵存疑，依词头 atole（粥糊）语境倾向'煮'；西语栏 lebadyxa 不可解。

entries.en: 〔gloss cannot be determined〕 doubtful reading of two characters
entries.notes: 汉栏全条[疑]且对音与'甘瀾'读音不合，西语栏 agle che 不可解，四栏无法互证。

entries.zh: 粽、粽子（首字存疑，或为'粥'）
entries.notes: 首字粽/粥存疑，倾向'粽'；西语栏与前条同为不可解的 atole agle che。

entries.zh: 〔语义无法定夺〕樹（或作拙，字存疑）
entries.en: 〔gloss cannot be determined〕 doubtful: 'tree / to plant (establish)' vs 'clumsy'
entries.notes: 西语栏 A formantar 非常规范式，对音与两候选字均不合，四栏无法互证。

entries.zh: 夹、钳挤（两侧夹住）；夹磨、折磨（若西语为 atormentar）
entries.en: to pinch, squeeze between two surfaces; to torment, press hard (if atormentar)
entries.notes: 西语栏 ator mentar 疑为 atormentar 之误分写，主释义依汉栏'夹'。

entries.en: to join, connect; to receive, meet
entries.notes: M/R 两栏对音与'接'读音不合，疑栏内误读或该字另有异读；西语栏为花体误分写。

entries.en: to beckon, summon or attract, bring (traer); to incite, provoke (incitar); to induce (inducir)

entries.zh: 招做夥（招聚成伙、纠集成群）
entries.en: to gather people together, form a group or gang (hacer juntamente); to recruit into company
entries.notes: 汉栏中字做/佐存疑，依词头'结聚'义倾向'做夥'。

entries.en: 〔gloss cannot be determined〕 literally 'city people / grown people look (at)'
entries.notes: 西语栏 medic̄o 不可解、汉栏首字[疑]，四栏无法互证整体语义。

entries.zh: 款留（殷勤恳留客人住下）
entries.en: to urge a guest to stay, detain courteously while entreating him (rogándole)
to go after someone, follow close behind; to tail after
entries.notes: R 栏后段 T99 污损；西/汉/闽三栏互证清晰、释义可靠，按门禁（含 T99 降 low）处理。

entries.zh: 绊、绊倒（绊住脚使跌）；阻绊、妨碍
entries.en: to trip up, cause to stumble; to obstruct, get in the way
